mapper.select: SELECT land.*, land_type.type_name AS type_name, land_type.description AS type_description, user_a.username AS customerA_username, user_a.phone AS customerA_phone, user_b.username AS employee_username, user_b.phone AS employee_phone FROM land INNER JOIN land_type ON land.land_type = land_type.id INNER JOIN user AS user_a ON land.a_id = user_a.id INNER JOIN user AS user_b ON land.employee_id = user_b.id;

SELECT land.*, land_type.type_name AS type_name, land_type.description AS type_description, user_a.username AS user_username, user_a.phone AS user_phone, user_b.username AS employee_username, user_b.phone AS employee_phone FROM land INNER JOIN land_type ON land.land_type = land_type.id INNER JOIN user AS user_a ON land.a_id = user_a.id INNER JOIN user AS user_b ON land.employee_id = user_b.id where land.id=#{id}
